'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Jan Westergard LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jan Westergaard
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
